dreams.narrative: I had the office dream again - the third time. Same empty floor, same fluorescent flicker, same mechanical typing coming from nowhere. But this time I found the stairs - they were where they've always actually been, past the kitchen, and I just walked down them and out. No water, no sideways elevator.
dreams.interpretation: I've had three dreams about being trapped in that building and the first two ended with no exit and this one didn't - it felt like my own brain had handed me something slightly on the nose, though I'm not going to pretend a dream means anything causal.
